portInfo.description: Svolvær is Lofoten’s administrative town harbour under Vågan Havnevesen KF, with separate west and east cruise-capable harbours. Visit Lofoten Cruise publishes the LOA/depth caps above and notes east-side tender distance 0.6 n. The municipal Øst page describes ~400 m of public quay used by Hurtigruten, cruise and cargo, with a stated depth limit of 7 m and weather drag from the southwest — reconcile with the 6 m Visit Lofoten figure before import. Door GPS null. Broader Lofoten landings also use Leknes (lofoten-islands-norway).

thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask east vs west harbour before assuming a flat town walk.
